breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π * d^4 / 32 (the polar moment of inertia) in the torsional strain energy formula U = ∫[0→L] T^2/(2GJ) dx. There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in place of J, which was the error in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
